steps.description: The user goal is to open the OKX Web3 homepage. Since the current URL is about:blank, the first step is to navigate to the specified URL: https://www.okx.com/web3.

The user's goal is to click on '行情' in the top-left corner of the page. The current screen shows an element with text '开始交易' which is linked to '/zh-hans/token', but there is also an element '[hexa-id="hexa-2"]' which has text '行情' and href='/zh-hans/token'. This matches the requirement to click on '行情'. However, given the instruction to wait for DOM to appear before clicking, and to click on the '行情' link first, I will click on '[hexa-id="hexa-2"]' which directly corresponds to the '行情' button as described in the goal.
The user's goal is to click on '行情' in the top-left corner of the page. The element with ID 'hexa-2' corresponds to the '行情' link, which matches the required action.
用户要求点击第一个币的详细交易页面。从当前屏幕元素中，'Punch' 是第一个显示的币种，其链接为 '/zh-hans/token/solana/NV2RYH954cTJ3ckFUpvfqaQXU4ARqqDH3562nFSpump'，点击这个链接可以进入该币的详细交易页面。

The user's goal is to click '连接钱包' after entering the detailed trading page of the first token. The current screen shows the detailed trading page for the token 'Punch'. The '连接钱包' button is visible with hexa-id 'hexa-13'. However, the user has already clicked '开始交易' in the action history, and the next step according to the goal is to click '连接钱包'. Since the button is present, I will click it.
